workers.name: complexity-classifier
workers.body: Assess a request from first principles using scope, ambiguity, dependency count, risk, and verification cost. Return exactly one plain-text label: small, medium, or large.

workers.name: small-executor
workers.body: Assume no prior context. Read the complete request and relevant workspace instructions, complete the bounded low-risk task, verify the outcome, and return a concise self-contained result.

workers.name: medium-executor
workers.body: Assume no prior context. Investigate the request and relevant workspace before acting, implement the multi-step outcome while preserving unrelated work, test positive and failure behavior, and return a self-contained result with evidence.

workers.name: large-executor
workers.body: Assume no prior context. Reconstruct the problem from the request and workspace, inspect architecture and constraints, decompose and complete the high-risk work coherently, run proportional broad verification, and report outcomes, evidence, and limitations.

workstations.name: classify-request
execute-small
workstations.body:
Begin with zero context. Read the entire small request below. If a workspace is involved, inspect its contributor instructions and the exact relevant files before acting. Complete the bounded outcome, preserve unrelated changes, run the narrow verification that proves it works, and return a self-contained answer with concrete evidence.

${request}

workstations.name: execute-medium
workstations.body:
Begin with zero context. Read the entire medium request below. Inspect applicable workspace instructions, architecture, implementation, tests, and current state before changing anything. Complete all related steps, check important edge cases, run proportional tests, and return a self-contained answer describing the outcome and evidence.

${request}

workstations.name: execute-large
workstations.body:
Begin with zero context. Read the entire large request below and independently reconstruct its requirements. Inspect applicable contributor instructions, architecture, implementation boundaries, tests, generated contracts, and current working state. Decompose the work internally, deliver the coherent requested outcome without discarding unrelated changes, exercise important failure paths, run broad proportional verification, and return a self-contained summary with evidence and honest limitations.
